head: codex/5875-migration-state-machine
title: [v0.92][WP-04.13] Migration state machine
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5875

## Summary
- adds the bounded durable prepare-to-owner-commit migration state machine
- binds placement, snapshot, fencing, activation, quiescence, and isolated restore to authoritative producers
- reconciles crash windows and live authority on exact retries while retaining bounded authenticated pre-fence rollback
- persists and enforces checked migration deadlines with adapter time budgets

## Validation
- focused nextest: 4 passed, 0 skipped
- strict focused Clippy: passed
- deep WP-04.13 receipt: PASS with 10 machine-derived negative cases
- independent exact-head review: APPROVE at 616b007b986cffeae92444e62382685b4a3c83c5
- git diff --check: passed

## Scope
- product changes are limited to adl-runtime/src/distributed/migration.rs and adl-runtime/tests/distributed_migration.rs
- production module registration remains owned by integration issue #5878
